alex_dev: quick heads-up — ran into a client-side queuing/tilt issue across SDKs when pagination + auth retries combine. repro in sampleapp.
maria_pm: ugh, describe "tilt" pls? :thinking_face:
sam_swe: that phrase made me laugh, but yeah — can you paste the minimal repro? I can try on Go and JS.
alex_dev: here's the stripped down flow — token refresh triggers during an in-flight paginated stream, retries re-enqueue page requests, client window doubles, backend sees burst and returns 429. observed more in Go binding.
alex_dev: ```
// pseudo
for page := range pager.Pages() {
  items := page.Items()
  // call inference SDK which may trigger auth refresh (sync)
  client.Generate(ctx, items)
}
```
alex_dev: If auth refresh happens synchronously inside Generate, Go's concurrency limiter lets the original goroutine resume and schedule more page fetches before backpressure drains — ends up with a burst.
tori_devx: interesting. JS SDK has a microtask queue and the auth refresh path is async so it naturally yields. Could be a parity gap in how we block on auth.
sam_swe: can you share logs? especially queue depth / semaphore logs + 429 spikes.
alex_dev: pasted a short log snippet (trimmed):
```
[00:01:23] pager: page 3 start
[00:01:23] generate: auth refresh start
[00:01:24] generate: auth refresh finish
[00:01:24] pager: page 4 start
[00:01:24] pager: page 5 start
[00:01:24] client: concurrency window=6 (limit=3)
[00:01:24] backend: 429 burst
```
maria_pm: ok that pattern maps to our leaky semaphore behavior when callbacks resume on same scheduler without yielding.
ci-bot: note: created issue #DEVEX-948: "client-window-burst-on-auth-retry" and attached logs
sam_swe: quick mitigation options: (1) block page fetcher until Generate returns even on auth refresh, (2) ensure auth refresh yields to scheduler, (3) add fast-path that converts auth refresh to async from caller perspective.
tori_devx: for parity, we should align Go SDK to Promise-like yield — introduce a tiny goroutine yield after auth refresh step or use a channel to hand the work off.
alex_dev: i prototyped option (1) as a patch in sampleapp: `pager.FetchBlocking = true` and burst disappears. but it's heavier for latency.
maria_pm: maybe add adaptive backpressure: if auth-refresh detected, temporarily drop pager prefetch to 1 for that session.
sam_swe: agreed. keep perf tradeoffs explicit in docs. also add a unit/integration test that injects blocking auth refresh and measures queue depth.
tori_devx: i'll make a quick PR to Go SDK to yield after auth refresh; will add a flag to opt-in until we ship parity. tagging @sam_swe for review.
alex_dev: thanks — can we also update the onboarding sampleapp to include this repro and a README note? saves future head-scratching.
maria_pm: recorded action items: 1) PR Go SDK yield after auth refresh (tori), 2) add sampleapp repro + README (alex), 3) integration test for queue tilt (sam), 4) add note in devex docs about auth-retry backpressure (maria).
alex_dev: :thumbsup: will add the sampleapp soon.
